reviews.title: GREED WITH ADS
reviews.text: Has the potential to be a fun game. Downloaded yesterday. Played for hours and hours and there was quite a bit of adsà but they would allow you so close them out within 10 seconds. So each ad would be a maximum of 20 seconds after you closed all the boxes. Open it up today, very first ad is over 2 minutes. Figured maybe it’s just because it’s the first ad. Nope I’ve been playing for about 15 minutes and out of that 15 minutes at least 10 minutes was watching ads. I’m sorry but that is greed to the highest level. I know they make a minimal amount on the quick close out ads but I played for at least 5 hours. Probably would have played another 5+ hours today. And who knows how many weeks or months I would have continued to play on a daily basis. So they would have made some money off me. But now that I see the developers are full of PURE GREED I’m just going to delete the game and now they’re going to miss out on my months and months of watching quick ads. IM SORRY BUT IT IS 100% A LIE THAT THEY HAVE 4.8 STARS. DO YOU NOTICE THAT ALL THESE GAMES ALWAYS HAVE EXACTLY 4.8 STARS. ABSOLUTE LIES.
